Fig. 4.1 shows a solar still. A solar still uses processes in the water cycle to produce drinking water.

![Diagram of a solar desalination device with a clear plastic dome. Sun heats salt water; water vapour condenses and collects as clean water.](assets/001-diagram-of-a-solar-desalination-device-with-a-cl.png)

**Fig. 4.1**

Use Fig. 4.1 and processes in the water cycle to explain how the solar still can produce drinking water.

Fig. 1.1 represents a simplified water cycle.

![Diagram illustrating the water cycle, showing processes like evaporation, transpiration, condensation, precipitation, infiltration, and ground flow.](assets/002-diagram-illustrating-the-water-cycle-showing-pro.png)
